# LumasPdf SDK — VB6 example mirror

VB6 mirror of `examples\delphi` (the LumasPDF vendor examples, running on `LumasPdf.dll`).
Each Delphi example is translated 1:1 to a VB6 project (`<name>.bas` + `<name>.vbp`).

## Shared wrapper (do not edit — generated by `tools\gen_vb.py`)
`LumasPdf.bas` (consts/enums/UDTs) + `LumasPdfApi1.bas`..`LumasPdfApi4.bas` (Declares).
VB6 caps identifiers per module, so the 1623 Declares are split across 4 modules; every
example `.vbp` references **all five**.

## Build
```
tools\build_vb6.bat <project.vbp> [errlog.txt]      REM headless VB6 /make
```
Declares are late-bound, so the DLL isn't needed to COMPILE — only to RUN. The VB6 exe is
32-bit: copy `x32\LumasPdf.dll` next to the exe (or put it on PATH) before running.

## Translation rules (Delphi OO `TPDF` → flat VB6)
| Delphi (LumasPdf.pas, OO) | VB6 (flat LumasPdf.bas) |
|---|---|
| `pdf := TPDF.Create` | `pdf = pdfNewPDF()`  (`Dim pdf As Long`) |
| `pdf.Free` | `pdfDeletePDF pdf` |
| `pdf.Method(a, b)` | `pdfMethod pdf, a, b`  (handle first) |
| a method taking a `string` | use the **`A`** export: `pdf.SetFont(..)` → `pdfSetFontA pdf, ..` |
| `true` / `false` | `1` / `0`  (LongBool) |
| `@ErrProc` callback arg | `AddressOf ErrProc` (the callback stays a `Public Function` in the .bas, `stdcall` is implicit) |
| `Writeln(x)` | `Debug.Print x` |
| Delphi `record` type | VB6 `Type ... End Type` (declare in the module) |
| `Array[0..N] of T` const | fill a VB6 array at runtime, or `Dim ... As T` + assignments |
| enum members (`cp1252`,`fmFill`,`dtFit`,`clRed`,`fsBold`,...) | already Long consts/enums in `LumasPdf.bas` — use as-is |
| `ExtractFilePath(ParamStr(0))` | `App.Path & "\"` |

Look up each flat export's exact name (A/W suffix) and arg types by grepping the wrapper,
e.g. `findstr /I "pdfSetFontA" LumasPdf*.bas`. Ints/handles/pointers are `Long`, coords are
`Double`, colours/flags `Long`, strings `String` (for the A exports).

## `.vbp` format (use this minimal form — a fuller field set breaks VB6 /make startup)
```
Type=Exe
Module=LumasPdf; ..\LumasPdf.bas
Module=LumasPdfApi1; ..\LumasPdfApi1.bas
Module=LumasPdfApi2; ..\LumasPdfApi2.bas
Module=LumasPdfApi3; ..\LumasPdfApi3.bas
Module=LumasPdfApi4; ..\LumasPdfApi4.bas
Module=mod<Name>; <name>.bas
Startup="Sub Main"
ExeName32="<name>.exe"
Name="<name>"
```
Adjust the `..\` prefix to the folder depth (depth-1 folder → `..\`, depth-2 → `..\..\`).
The `.bas` starts with `Attribute VB_Name = "mod<Name>"`, `Option Explicit`, and a
`Public Sub Main()`.

## Gotchas
- **CRLF required.** `.bas` and `.vbp` must have Windows (CRLF) line endings. LF-only files make
  `VB6 /make` fail with the misleading `Must have startup form or Sub Main()` (NOT a code error).
  Normalise before building: `sed -i 's/\r$//; s/$/\r/' *.bas *.vbp`.
- **VCL colour constants** (`clRed`,`clYellow`,`clBlue`,`clBlack`,`clGray`,`clLtGray`,`clCream`,
  `NO_COLOR`) are not in the wrapper — declare them module-local as `Private Const` with the
  standard TColor values (clRed=255, clYellow=65535, clBlue=16711680, clGray=8421504,
  clLtGray=12632256, clCream=15793151, NO_COLOR=&HFFFFFFF1).
- Pointer args (`@p`, `@arr[0]`) → `VarPtr(...)`; `SizeOf(p)` → `LenB(p)`; error callback →
  `Public Function PDFError(...) As Long` (return 0) passed via `AddressOf`.
- A few string exports have NO `A` suffix (e.g. `pdfCreateTextField`, `pdfCreateCheckBox`,
  `pdfCreateComboBox`, `pdfCreateListBox`, `pdfSetLanguage`) — always confirm by grepping the wrapper.

`smoke_test\` — proven end-to-end (compiles → runs → writes `smoke_out.pdf`).
